## Summary

Describe the user-visible change and its scientific or operational purpose.

## Verification

- [ ] Tests cover the calculation and failure modes.
- [ ] Units, boundaries, assumptions, and provenance are explicit.
- [ ] Documentation and schemas are updated where applicable.
- [ ] `ruff`, `pytest`, build, and distribution checks pass.

## Data and licensing

- [ ] No restricted data is committed or redistributed.
- [ ] New bundled factors have a source, version, licence, range, and tests.
